description: The JSON boundary of the host contract (docs/hosting.md) and the json module: integer precision, null, empty arrays, nesting limits and Unicode.

cases.name: input: 2^53 - 1 and -(2^53 - 1) are exact
input: -(2^53) - 1 is rejected

expectError.messageContains: integer -9007199254740993 is outside +/-2^53 and would lose precision as a Lua number; send it as a string

cases.name: input: a fraction or exponent is a float, even past 2^53
cases.source: return function(t) return { tostring(t[1]), tostring(t[2]), tostring(t[3]) } end
cases.note: only integer literals without a fraction or exponent are range-checked, so 9007199254740993.0 rounds

cases.name: input: 64-bit ids as strings stay exact
input: invalid JSON is an input error

expectError.messageContains: invalid JSON at offset 3: unexpected end of input

cases.name: input: an infinite number is an input error

expectError.messageContains: invalid JSON at offset 1: invalid number '1e400'

cases.name: input: null in an object drops the key, in an array keeps the position
cases.source: return function(t) local n = 0 for _ in pairs(t.o) do n = n + 1 end return { n, #t.a, json.isnull(t.a[2]), t.a } end

cases.name: input: Unicode escapes and surrogate pairs
cases.source: return function(t) return { t[1], #t[1], t[2], #t[2], t[3] } end

cases.name: input: empty array and empty object
cases.source: return function(t) return { t.a, t.o, json.isemptyarray(t.a), next(t.o) == nil } end

cases.name: input: nesting of 128 arrays is accepted
cases.source: return function(t) local d = 0 while type(t) == 'table' do d = d + 1 t = t[1] end return d end

cases.name: input: nesting of 129 arrays is rejected

expectError.messageContains: invalid JSON at offset 129: nesting deeper than 128

cases.name: output: json.emptyarray() is [] and an empty table is {}
cases.source: return { a = json.emptyarray(), o = {}, n = { json.emptyarray() } }

cases.name: output: json.null() keeps a position
output: sparse integer keys become an object
output: mixed keys become an object with string keys
output: integer-valued floats are integers, 2^53 included
output: large and small floats
output: NaN is an output error

expectError.messageContains: $[1]: NaN and infinity have no JSON representation

cases.name: output: infinity is an output error

expectError.messageContains: $.x: NaN and infinity have no JSON representation

cases.name: output: a function is an output error

expectError.messageContains: $.f: a function cannot be converted to JSON

cases.name: output: a reference cycle is an output error
cases.source: local t = {} t.self = t return t

cases.name: output: a boolean key is an output error

expectError.messageContains: $: a boolean key cannot be a JSON object key

cases.name: output: a fractional number key is an output error

expectError.messageContains: $: a number key cannot be a JSON object key

cases.name: output: control characters are escaped
output: nesting of 128 tables is accepted
cases.source: local t = 1 for i = 1, 128 do t = { t } end return t

cases.name: output: nesting of 129 tables is rejected
cases.source: local t = 1 for i = 1, 129 do t = { t } end return t

cases.name: output: several return values keep the first
json module: parse and serialize round trip
cases.source: local t = json.parse('{"a":[1,2,{"b":null}],"c":"é\\n"}') return { json.serialize(t.a), t.c, json.isnull(t.a[3].b) }

cases.name: json module: \u escapes are not parsed
cases.note: a bug: the json module reads strings with the Lua lexer, which expects \u{...}

cases.name: json module: [[ is read as a Lua long string
cases.note: a bug: the json module reads input with the Lua lexer; '[ [1] ]' parses

cases.name: json module: empty arrays survive a round trip only when asked
json module: number formatting
json module: nesting of 128 arrays round-trips
cases.source: local s = string.rep('[ ', 128) .. '1' .. string.rep(' ]', 128) return json.serialize(json.parse(s)) == (s:gsub(' ', ''))

cases.name: json module: invalid JSON is a runtime error
